lead: A `grep … | head` that finds nothing is not the same as a grep that finds nothing.
body: The lines `head` keeps can end one line before the rows you are asking about, so a handoff that reports "X is not written yet" on that evidence sizes the next slice at half its real scope. Never `| head` a grep whose result you are about to assert is empty (use `-c`, `-l`, or no pipe at all), and re-check a handoff's "not written yet" in one call before scoping around it.
